environment.local_machine_caveat: Results are from one local development machine using Docker Compose. They are not production capacity.

definitions.submission_latency_ms: client perf_counter immediately before POST until full HTTP response
definitions.submitted_jobs_per_sec: HTTP 202 count / client submission wall-clock seconds
definitions.completed_jobs_per_sec: SUCCEEDED measured jobs / (submit wall + wait-until-terminal wall)
definitions.percentile: linear interpolation at rank (p/100)*(n-1); p99 omitted if n<50
definitions.http_reuse: one httpx.AsyncClient per batch with keepalive; semaphore concurrency
definitions.completion_observation: batched read-only SQL every 400ms; no per-job GET polling

cpu_calibration.note: handler cap is 100000; target 100-500ms may be unreachable on this CPU

eight_workers: skipped; 1/2/4 are the canonical scaling points
